title: Mansmann letters describe domed disc on film

tellings.quote: Florence mansman analyzed the film frame by frame with a magnifier what's called a loop magnifier and he's on record by the mid 80s he was writing to Jacobs in private letters saying what I saw with the magnifier was a disc-shaped object with a dome

plain: A man named Florenze Mansmann studied film shot at Vandenberg Air Force Base in 1964, going through it frame by frame with a loupe magnifier, and saw on it a disc-shaped object with a dome. Robert Hastings, a researcher who studies UFOs at nuclear weapons sites, tells Michels this, citing private letters Mansmann wrote in the mid-1980s to a man named Robert Jacobs, in which, Hastings says, Mansmann wrote that what he saw with the magnifier was "a disc-shaped object with a dome." If true, it would mean a military film caught a flying disc.
